description: Construct Zwick's deterministic unweighted witness-prefix bridging set by greedy hitting set.

source.title: All Pairs Shortest Paths using Bridging Sets and Rectangular Matrix Multiplication
source.implementation_status: bounded deterministic find-bridge kernel over supplied validated shortest-path witnesses

input.encoding: [n,s,A[n*n],W[n*n]] with row-major directed adjacency and witness matrices; W=0 means direct/empty path and W=v+1 means split at internal vertex v

output.encoding: bit v is 1 iff vertex v is selected into the deterministic greedy bridge set

contract.graph_model: Loop-free strongly connected directed graph with unit edge weights; diagonal distance is zero.
contract.witness_model: Every non-direct witness recursively splits an actual shortest path at an internal vertex; both subpath distances are strictly smaller than the whole path distance.
contract.primary_method: For each ordered pair in row-major order, recursively extract up to s internal path vertices, union with both endpoints, retain each constraint whose set size is at least s, and coalesce identical vertex masks at first occurrence as C <- C union {U_ij}; then repeatedly choose the vertex hitting the most unhit constraints, with lowest-ID ties.
contract.independent_method: Iteratively expand each witness pair into its complete path, take the first s internal vertices, form the same set family by coalescing identical masks at first occurrence, and run the deterministic greedy hitting pass.
contract.input_bounds: 2<=n<=8, 2<=s<=n, exact frame length 2+2*n*n; each adjacency entry is 0 or 1, diagonal entries are zero, and all ordered pairs are reachable.
contract.complexity: O(n^3+n^2*s+n^4) time and O(n^2) storage for both bounded references.
contract.workspace_bound: 4096 bytes, including bounded graph/distance/witness tables, at most n*n constraint masks, path scratch, parser locals, and scalar result.
contract.invalid_cases: Null input, invalid dimensions/threshold, wrong or trailing frame length, non-Boolean adjacency, self-loop, non-strongly-connected graph, out-of-range witness, direct-path mismatch, or a witness split that is not shortest returns -1.
